heightmap3d_landscape.mechanism: sub-ULP cross-GPU divergence flips the landscape raymarch's discrete voxel-presence test in the shared volume atlas (measured: 663/262144 atlas voxels appear or drop outright while every other cell stays within 1/255), so isolated single terrain-edge pixels flip

heightmap3d_landscape_isosurface.mechanism: sub-ULP cross-GPU divergence flips the isosurface landscape raymarch's discrete voxel-presence test in the shared volume atlas (measured: 663/262144 atlas voxels appear or drop outright while every other cell stays within 1/255), so isolated single terrain-edge pixels flip
